ex.en: Tom and Mary argue with each other all the time.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗總是在吵架。

ex.en: I argued with Yoko a little bit.
It is no use arguing with him about it.
ex.zh: 跟他爭論這件事是沒用的。

ex.en: Columbus argued that he could reach India by going west.
ex.zh: 哥倫布主張往西航行可以到達印度。

ex.en: Some experts argue that the plan will not work.
ex.zh: 有些專家認為這個計畫行不通。

ex.en: I created an archive of my emails.
ex.zh: 我把電子郵件都做了封存備份。
我正在下載這份網路封存資料。

ex.en: Old emails are archived automatically after a year.
ex.zh: 舊郵件一年後會自動封存。

ex.en: Please archive these files at the end of the project.
ex.zh: 專案結束後請把這些檔案歸檔。

ex.en: The precise time of their arrival is not known.
ex.zh: 他們到達的確切時間還不明。

ex.en: On his arrival at the station, he called a taxi.
ex.zh: 他到了火車站，就叫了輛計程車。

ex.en: What's the flight's scheduled arrival time?
With the arrival of winter, leaves fall from the trees.
ex.zh: 樹上的葉子隨著冬天的到來而掉落。

ex.en: The arrival of spring brings warmer weather.
ex.zh: 春天到來，天氣也跟著變暖了。

ex.en: Sometimes he has difficulty being articulate about his views.
ex.zh: 他有時很難把自己的看法說清楚。
她是一位口才很好的講者。

ex.en: He found it hard to articulate his feelings.
ex.zh: 他覺得很難清楚說出自己的感受。

ex.en: Try to articulate your main point in one sentence.
ex.zh: 試著用一句話清楚說出你的重點。
